text: SELECT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles, di.efo_id AS efo_id, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND di.efo_term LIKE '%non-small cell lung carcinoma%'
